text: Anyone can write award winner on a CV. So how would you ever check?
I see healthcare awards on CVs every week. Most of them, I can't verify. So I ignore them.
Evinca was built for that exact problem. Every honour links to a live public record. No login needed. Start with the Honorees Register.
Search by name, country or category. And notice the honesty: it says plainly that this is a publisher's record, not a licence to practise. Every profile here is a labelled, illustrative example.
Let's type a name. Amina Rahman. A midwife and unit quality lead, in Amman, Jordan.
Her profile shows the approved summary. A structured handover that cut missed escalation signals on a maternity unit. Then, open the proof page.
Here is the public proof. Current status: active. This honour is current and valid.
The record ID, the category, the date it was issued, the decision pathway, and the reviewers' roles. Even the rubric is named, and openly labelled as a pilot, unvalidated.

Then the Evidence Passport. What was measured. The baseline. Who verified it. The caveats: a single site, and staffing also changed. And what stays private: raw audit sheets with patient identifiers are withheld.
Wait. It actually tells me the limits of the evidence?
And yes, there is a certificate. A record number, a fingerprint, and a QR code that opens this exact page. Shown here as a sample.
Got a certificate in front of you? Go to Verify, and type the record ID.
E V N, demo, P 8 W D. Find record.
David Chen. Status: corrected. The record was corrected, the honour remains valid, and the history stays visible. Even corrections happen in public.

And the method is published before the recognition. Four steps, held in public. Automatic evidence checks first, then a named reviewer decides. Conflicts, borderline scores and appeals go to an external reviewer.
Even the scoring weights are on the page. Twenty five points for evidence quality. Every decision made by a person, never by software.
Okay. That's an award I can actually check.
Recognition you can verify. Impact you can understand. Start free today, at Evinca dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
